title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A psychological thriller about Alicia Berenson, a painter who stops speaking after being accused of murdering her husband. A psychotherapist tries to uncover the mystery behind her silence.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A young shepherd named Santiago travels in search of treasure and discovers the importance of following dreams, listening to his heart, and finding his personal legend.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A classic American novel about Jay Gatsby, his mysterious wealth, and his pursuit of love during the Jazz Age of the 1920s.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet navigates love, family expectations, social class, and misunderstandings in this timeless romantic novel.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: An introduction to the universe, black holes, time, space, and the fundamental questions of modern physics.

title: The Selfish Gene
author: Richard Dawkins
description: A fascinating exploration of evolution, natural selection, and the role of genes in shaping living organisms.

title: Cosmos
author: Carl Sagan
description: A journey through astronomy, scientific discovery, the origins of life, and humanity's place in the universe.

title: The Gene
author: Siddhartha Mukherjee
description: A history of genetics that explains heredity, scientific discoveries, and how genes influence human life.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: An exploration of human history, from early hunter-gatherers to modern civilization, examining the forces that shaped humanity.

title: The Diary of a Young Girl
author: Anne Frank
description: The personal diary of Anne Frank, documenting her thoughts, hopes, and experiences while hiding during World War II.

title: The Silk Roads
author: Peter Frankopan
description: A fresh perspective on world history exploring how trade routes connecting East and West shaped civilizations, cultures, and empires.

title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
author: Jared Diamond
description: An exploration of how geography, environment, agriculture, and technology influenced the development of human societies.

title: Charlotte's Web
author: E. B. White
description: A heartwarming story about a pig named Wilbur and a clever spider named Charlotte, whose friendship teaches kindness and loyalty.

title: Matilda
author: Roald Dahl
description: Matilda is a brilliant young girl with extraordinary powers who uses her intelligence and courage to stand up against unfair adults.

title: The Little Prince
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupery
description: A young prince travels between planets and meets unusual characters, discovering lessons about friendship, love, responsibility, and life.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
description: Alice falls into a magical world filled with strange creatures, curious adventures, and unforgettable characters.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits, breaking bad ones, and making small improvements that create meaningful long-term results.

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
description: A guide to focused and distraction-free work that explains how concentration can improve productivity and help people achieve meaningful goals.

title: The Psychology of Money
author: Morgan Housel
description: An engaging collection of stories about how emotions, behavior, and personal experiences influence financial decisions and wealth building.

title: Think Again
author: Adam Grant
description: An exploration of the value of rethinking assumptions, questioning beliefs, and remaining open to new ideas in work and everyday life.
